signals.thesis: Eli Lilly breaking above $1000 psychological resistance on GLP-1 pipeline momentum. Mounjaro/Zepbound revenue acceleration + orforglipron oral GLP-1 data readout. BUY signal active since Apr 30 at $902 — now +12.7%. Strongest momentum in the scan with breakout confirmation above prior resistance.

Trump-Xi Beijing summit is the strongest near-term catalyst for Chinese equities. FXI breaking above EMA200 ($37.43) on massive volume (212M shares). RSI 65.5 with bullish MACD crossover. Price above all moving averages for first time in 3 months. CEOs traveling with Trump signals potential trade deal concessions.

Alphabet momentum play on AI Search + Cloud growth re-acceleration. Price recovered from $318 support to $402 (+26% in 3 weeks). BUY signal from Apr 24 at $340.71 still active with +18.1% follow-through. Gemini AI integration across Search, Cloud, and Workspace driving revenue upside.

Japan ETF in confirmed uptrend — price $92.85 above EMA20 ($89.76), EMA50 ($88.18), EMA200 ($83.58). RSI 66.4 (bullish, not overbought). BUY signal active since Apr 30. Yen weakness + BOJ policy normalization + corporate governance reforms driving institutional flows into Japanese equities.

Meta momentum sustained at $616 with BUY signal active from May 7. AI-driven ad targeting efficiency gains + Reels monetization acceleration. Llama open-source AI strategy reducing compute costs while expanding developer ecosystem. Revenue grew 22% last quarter. Price holding above key support despite market volatility.

Uber fresh BUY signal May 12 at $76.36. Ride-share + delivery platform benefiting from consumer recovery. Autonomous vehicle partnerships (Waymo integration) expanding addressable market. Gross bookings growth accelerating to +20% YoY. Free cash flow inflection confirmed — stock re-rating from growth to GARP.

GE Aerospace pullback from $311.79 high to $295 — textbook dip-buy in ongoing uptrend. 8-K filing today signals material event (potential contract or guidance update). Commercial aviation aftermarket revenue surging on record global air traffic. LEAP engine installed base driving multi-decade service revenue stream. Defense segment benefits from geopolitical spending acceleration.

TotalEnergies momentum on hot PPI (+6% YoY) confirming inflation persistence — energy sector direct beneficiary. BUY signal active since Apr 29. Integrated energy model with growing LNG portfolio. 4%+ dividend yield. EU energy security premium. +15.9% since March low at $78.25. DXY weakness amplifies EUR-denominated returns.

XLE energy ETF as inflation hedge — PPI surging +6% YoY with energy component leading. BUY signal from Apr 23 at $56.98 still active. Broad energy sector exposure (XOM, CVX, COP, EOG) captures the oil supply constraint + geopolitical premium without single-stock risk. +27% since November low. Daily pullback to $57.55 from $59.76 high is entry opportunity.

BBVA breakout above $21 resistance zone — EU banking sector rally driven by higher rates and improving credit quality. BUY signal active since Mar 31 at $21.01 with +3.8% follow-through. Sabadell acquisition expanding domestic market share. NII tailwind from ECB rate normalization. +12.1% since November signal. Forward PE attractive at ~7x.
